me:2006:q28.title: GATE ME 2006 | Set 1 | Question: 28
me:2006:q28.question:
Consider a continuous random variable with probability density function
$f(t)= 1+t$ for $-1\leq t \leq 0$
$f(t)= 1-t$ for $0\leq t \leq 1$
The standard deviation of the random variable is:

detailed_solution.markdown:
Mean $(\bar{t})=\int_{-1}^{\infty} t \cdot f(t) \cdot d t$

$\quad=\int_{-1}^{0} t(1+t) d t+\int_{0}^{1} t(1-t) d t$

$\quad=\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}+\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}-\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{1}$

$\quad=-\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right]+\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right]$

$=-\left[\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\right]=0$

Variance $=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}(t-\bar{t})^{2} f(t) d t$

$=\int_{-1}^{0} t^{2}(1+t) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t$

$=\int_{-1}^{0}\left(t^{2}+t^{3}\right) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t$

$=\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}+\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}-\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1}$

$=\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{12}=\frac{1}{6}$

Standard deviation

$=\sqrt{\text { variance }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}$

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

detailed_solution.markdown: Velocity of free stream, $U=10 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}$ Boundary layer thickness at section r-s, $\delta=10 \mathrm{mm}=0.01 \mathrm{m}$ Width of the plate: b=1m Density of the gas: $p=1 \mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{m}^{3}$ Linear velocity distribution, $u=U \frac{y}{\delta}$ Mass flow rate entering through section p q $$\begin{aligned} \dot{m} &=\rho A U=\rho b \delta U \\ &=1 \times 1 \times 0.01 \times 10=0.1 \mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{s} \end{aligned}$$ Mass flow rate entering through section s-r $$\begin{aligned} \dot{m}&=\int_{0}^{\delta} \rho a u=\int_{0}^{\delta} \rho b d y u \\ &=\rho b\int_{0}^{\delta}u d y=\rho b \int_{0}^{\delta} \frac{u y}{\delta} d y\\ &\left(\because u=\frac{U y}{\delta}\right) \\=& \frac{\rho b U^{\delta}}{\delta} \int_{0}^{\delta} y d y=\frac{\rho b U}{\delta}\left[\frac{y^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{\delta} \\=& \frac{\rho b U}{\delta} \times \frac{\delta^{2}}{2}=\frac{\rho b U \delta}{2} \\=& \frac{1 \times 1 \times 10 \times 0.01}{2}=0.05 \mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{s} \end{aligned}$$ Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

The thickness of the boundary layer at section r-s is 10 mm, the breadth of the plate is 1 m (into the paper) and the density of the gas $\rho = 1.0 kg/m^{3}$. detailed_solution.concept: Fluid Mechanics - Viscous, Turbulent Flow and Boundary Layer Theory
detailed_solution.markdown:
Drag force on plate = rate of change of momentum of the flowing fluid.

Momentum thickness: $\theta=\int_{0}^{\delta} \frac{u}{U}\left(\frac{1-u}{U}\right) d y$

$$\begin{aligned} \theta &=\int_{0}^{\delta} \frac{U}{\delta}\left(1-\frac{u}{\delta}\right) d y=\int_{0}^{\delta}\left(\frac{y}{\delta}-\frac{y^{2}}{\delta^{2}}\right) d y \\ &=\frac{y^{2}}{2 \delta}-\left.\frac{y^{3}}{3 \delta^{2}}\right|_{0} ^{\delta}=\frac{\delta}{2}-\frac{\delta}{3}=\frac{\delta}{6} \end{aligned}$$

$\therefore$Force on plate per unit width $=\delta U^{2} \times(\theta \times 1)$

$$\begin{aligned} \text { Here, } \quad U &=10 \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s} \\ &=1 \times(10)^{2} \times\left(\frac{10 \times 10^{-3}}{6} \times 1\right) \\ &=0.1666 \mathrm{N} \end{aligned}$$

Therefore, the correct answer is **C**.
